confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Melbourne price levels; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Cafe, pub and restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies by suburb, lead time and season (July is a quieter winter period). Cocktail and wine anchors were partly set from typical Melbourne price ratios to beer because direct drink-price knowledge is less precise. FX came from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page, which I did not open directly; verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city; based on Melbourne's own general price levels, benchmarked against other large Australian capitals such as Sydney and Brisbane from general knowledge. No external price data was retrieved.
